hints.title: Identify Command Patterns
hints.text: The input command contains only three distinct tokens: G, (), and (al).

hints.title: Single-Pass Scanner
hints.text: Scan through the command character by character, inspecting the next character when encountering an open parenthesis.

hints.title: Construct Output String
hints.text: Append G for G, o for (), and al for (al) to form the parsed result.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Chained string replacements could re-scan multiple times when a single pass suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear pass reconstructs the string in O(n) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements linear scanner or built-in replacement cleanly.
